name: Seminole Balsamo
desc: Seminole Balsamo (Psychotria nervosa): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 26 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Psychotria nervosa, also known as Seminole balsamo or wild coffee, is a shade tolerant medium-sized shrub native to Florida as well as the West Indies and Central and South America.
